description: A task whose deadline 0 is due at once acknowledges the Deadline and, in its cleanup (priority 210), spawns a child with an explicit budget (priority 128 by default), one that inherits its budget, and one whose budget sets priority 250. scope_with_budget clamps a budget's deadline and quotas to the spawner's but takes its priority unclamped (cx.rs:4547-4586), so the children are admitted at 128, 210 and 250 and run in priority order.
